## Personality

Mrs. Wiley is known for her strict and intimidating demeanor, instilling fear in those who have to interact with her. Her acknowledged talents include maintaining a clean home and producing high-quality butter.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P6](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0006)_

## History

Wiley originally came from [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). She suffered from a bad heart for years, and a doctor warned her that it might fail at any time.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P71](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0071), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008)_
